def findMajorityElement (lst : List Int) (h_precond : findMajorityElement_precond (lst)) : Int :=
  let n := lst.length
  let majorityCandidate := lst.foldl (fun acc x => if acc = -1 ∨ acc = x then acc else x) (-1)
  let count := fun x => (lst.filter (fun y => y = x)).length
  let isMajority x := count x > n / 2
  if isMajority majorityCandidate then majorityCandidate
  else -1
